newsitem.title: FRANCE: 600 held in France in mass paedophilia crackdown.
newsitem.headline: 600 held in France in mass paedophilia crackdown.

text.p: Gendarmes detained more than 600 people on Tuesday in France's widest ever swoop on paedophile video fans, a spokesman for the paramilitary police said.
He said the swoop followed 14 months of investigation which led the gendarmerie to a mail-order company in the central town of Macon selling pornographic films involving boys.
The operation -- dubbed "Ado 71" after the French word for teenager and the car registration figure for the Macon region -- involved some 2,500 gendarmes.

They fanned out from the early hours across mainland France as well as the French Caribbean islands of Martinique and Guadeloupe to search the homes of 800 people whose names were found on the company's mailing list.
Gendarmes seized 250 pornographic cassettes which the company had bought outside of France, mainly in Spain and Poland, and then copied.
State prosecutor Jean-Louis Coste, who oversaw the swoop, said investigators found a video shot by one of those detained and showing five boys being raped.
A court in the Loiret region on Tuesday jailed a 48-year old man for 18 years for raping and indecently assaulting 14 boys aged five to 10.

The crackdown also coincided with the country's first major paedophilia trial, in which 71 Frenchmen were in the dock accused of organising or subscribing to a network selling pornographic films involving boys.

Two of the main suspects, Miguel Caignet, 42, accused of promoting the cassettes in pornographic magazines, and Michel Meigniez, also 42, charged with organising their distribution, said they thought the boys in the films were over 18.
But lawyers for the civil plaintiffs say the young Colombians in the videos were paid to lie about their age. The trial is expected to continue until early July.
